# Write the change, not the engagement

Every case study that stalled in customer approval was framed around the engagement —
what we did — instead of the change: what became different in the customer's
operation. Customers approve descriptions of their own improvement readily and edit
descriptions of our work endlessly. Establish the one operational change in the
customer's framing first, and if no such change can be stated in one sentence, the
engagement is a reference call, not a case study yet.
